name: Lewd Island
source:
After a plane crash you and a female passenger find yourselves on an abandoned island.

Will help arrive?
Were there other survivors?
What will happen?
What will you find?
You play and YOU decide!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xred]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
飞机失事后，你和一名女乘客发现自己身处一座废弃的岛屿上。

会帮忙到达吗？
还有其他幸存者吗？
会发生什么？
你会发现什么？
你玩，你决定！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/xred]Patreon[/url]]
